title: Skeete's "Vibes Don't Lie" EP Showcases Infectious Summer Sounds
htmlContent:
Rising UK artist Skeete has consistently impressed audiences with his unique blend of R&B, soul, dancehall, and Afrobeats. With a string of successful tracks under his belt, including "Notice Me," "Independent Girl," "No More Love Songs," and "Weekdays (She Freaky, She Sneaky)," Skeete has amassed over 20 million streams and established a dedicated fanbase. Now, with the release of his EP, "Vibes Don't Lie," Skeete is set to elevate his career even further.

"Vibes Don't Lie" picks up where the infectious hit "Weekdays (She Freaky, She Sneaky)" left off. The EP seamlessly incorporates Skeete's Caribbean heritage and takes listeners on a fascinating ride filled with smooth R&B melodies, catchy dancehall rhythms, and an overall upbeat atmosphere that perfectly complements the summer season. The project is anchored by the new single "Tek Buddy," accompanied by a visually absorbing music video directed by Jack Stangaard. This track, along with the previously released lead single "Set It Arff," is bound to become yet another hit for Skeete, solidifying his position as one of the most exciting UK artists today.

Skeete explains that the inspiration behind "Vibes Don't Lie" came from the unexpected success of "Weekdays (She Freaky, She Sneaky)." He wanted to deliver new music for his fans, providing them with a similar sensual feel but with added variety. This EP certainly achieves that goal, offering a range of tracks that cater to both erotic and summery vibes, giving listeners the freedom to choose their preferred musical experience.

From the moment you press play, the EP transports you to a vibrant world of sun-soaked beaches, carefree moments, and electric energy. "Vibes Don't Lie" is available now on all major platforms, ready to transport you to a world of infectious rhythms and unforgettable melodies. Don't miss out on this incredible musical journey that solidifies Skeete's position in the industry.
